capabilities: keep the window always on top
disambiguation: Not a theme or CSS tool; it changes native Electron window properties, not note styling.
extras: README warns that not all settings work on all operating systems.
problem: Obsidian offers no built-in way to change window-level settings like opacity, vibrancy, or keeping the window on top of others.
summary: Electron window tweaker that adjusts window opacity, macOS vibrancy, and always-on-top behavior.
